Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-STATION-01
DOC-0037 2026-03-02
MEETING NOTES — Electrical Dependencies Between
Owning Desks
Date: 2026-03-02
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
Attendees: PERSON-0013 for TEAM-0001; supplying team's
coordinator; intake clerk; duty chair.
Purpose: Agree how the electrical desk follows dependencies
requiring an answer from another team. ISSUE-0162 and
TASK-0432 locate the folder used for the discussion.
Decisions Use separate owning-team and answering-team spaces
on the dependency sheet. The owning team keeps responsibility
for the next queue action while the answering team provides
the requested information. Sending a question across the desk
boundary does not transfer ownership.
Write the answer needed, its intended recipient, and a
promised contact time before leaving the meeting. The intake
clerk will check the contact plan at 15:00 and carry any
missed appointment into the next shift's sheet with its
original date.
If the teams cannot identify a receiving role, use
question-first escalation to the duty chair. Begin with the
missing answer and then state who will seek it and when. A
generic request to accelerate the queue gives the chair no
ownership decision to resolve.
Action items
— Owner: Supplying team's coordinator. Due: 2026-03-03. Name
the receiving role for dependency questions.
_ Owner: PERSON-0013. Due: 2026-03-03. Add the separate team
spaces to the working desk sheet.
D. Worker 0013
Demo Worker 0013, Demo Team 01
